newsitem.title: USA: Baxter unit files $600 mln debt securities.
newsitem.headline: Baxter unit files $600 mln debt securities.

text.p: Allegiance Corp, a unit of Baxter International Inc, filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $600 million in debt securities.
Allegiance, the largest provider of health-care products and cost management services for hopspital and other health care providers, is being spun-off to shareholders on September 30.
Net proceeds from the offering will be used to reduce amounts outstanding under the company's $1.2 billion credit facility, according to the filing.
The offering will be made through a group of underwriters led by Goldman, Sachs & Co.
